title: Cross-Validation Strategies for Multi-Series Time Series Forecasting
description:
Experiment code accompanying the SBPO 2026 paper On Cross-Validation Strategies for Autoregressive Forecasting.

The paper compares four cross-validation strategies (KFold, GroupKFold, GroupShuffleSplit, and TimeSeriesSplit) for multi-series forecasting with global models, under two deployment scenarios: forecasting the future of series seen in training, and forecasting series never seen in training. It evaluates calibration bias, Nadeau–Bengio interval coverage, window-selection regret, and multi-step autoregressive robustness across seven public datasets (Electricity, PEMS-BAY, METR-LA, GSOD, PAMAP2, MHEALTH, HAR) and five regression algorithms.

This repository holds the download, preprocessing, experiment, analysis, and figure-generation scripts. Raw data is not distributed; make download retrieves every dataset from its original source, listed with URLs and DOIs in datasets.json. Three fixed seeds control all stochastic operations and package versions are pinned, so a full re-run reproduces the published numbers.
